name: tokenmonk-probe-repo
description: Throwaway instrumentation plugin for the TokenMonk Cursor-capture M0 spikes. Installed from a Git repo to test whether plugin variables reach hook processes on a repo/marketplace install, as opposed to a local install. Records hook coverage locally; never blocks, denies, or sends anything off the machine.

TM_PROBE_VAR.title: Probe sentinel
TM_PROBE_VAR.description: Non-secret sentinel. If this value reaches the hook process, plugin variables are usable for config (PK-2 path a).

CAPTURE_ENDPOINT.title: Capture endpoint
CAPTURE_ENDPOINT.description: Shape-test only. Any URL will do.

CAPTURE_TOKEN.title: Capture token
CAPTURE_TOKEN.description: Shape-test only. The probe records ONLY whether this was substituted and its length, never its value. Do not put a real token here.
